subject: Small delay before our call?
text:
Hi there,

So sorry to send this so close to our chat. My laptop charger just stopped working, and I am trying to borrow one from the front desk before the community room opens. I do not want to start the call and lose the screen halfway through.

Could we push it to tomorrow, or even late this evening? I can also send a quick voice note with my updates if that is easier. Just let me know what saves the day.

Thanks for being flexible!
